assessment.diversity_evidence: All 20 stories share the same problem and causal sequence: Jun’s whale book is missing, the children search and notice a high-shelf clue, Ms Alvarez retrieves it, and they read together. Variants in whether Mina’s atlas is saved or returned and in wording such as “spotted” versus “saw” do not change the plot (for example, s000014 and s000028). This small sample indicates near-duplication, not the diversity of the entire generator.

plot_groups.summary: Jun cannot find his whale book; Mina helps search, a high-shelf clue reveals where it is, and Ms Alvarez retrieves it so the friends can read together.
